title: Elite Force SP save integrity
status: PARTIAL; checked writes/close and failure propagation fixed; both Elite Force profiles remain development-gated
correction: Sticky chunk failure prevents partial publication; close checks stream and final-flush errors. Failed saves do not print Done or advance a hub transition. Deliberate game save refusals retain their previous transition flow. Complete temporary file retained after replacement failure.

provenance.use: Independently found and implemented engine error handling; no external code incorporated. Retail save chunk order and successful save behavior retained.

platforms.windows: Windows x86 MSVC 19.44.35222; private inactive desktop, GLx
platforms.linux: Ubuntu 24.04.3 WSL i686 GCC 13.3 / Clang 18.1.3; compiled save regression under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. Retail SP runtime remains Windows x86 only.

beforeRegression.outcome: Expected failure: first failed fwrite reports success and replaces the original save
beforeRegression.scope: Initial extracted-function reproducer; the current tracked regression was then expanded with close, command, transition and recovery cases.

unitTests.command: python -m unittest stvef_sp_save_write_tests stvef_sp_savegame_tests rtcw_file_write_tests rtcw_savegame_tests windows_utf8_files_tests -v
unitTests.successfulRetries: One successful retry after each injected write boundary; additional primary success/refusal/recovery/command cases
unitTests.scope: Actual append/save/command/transition/FS_Write/checked-close functions; owned fixture game callbacks, checksum and file wrappers. Platform replacement behavior also tested separately and in real Windows runtime.

fixtureInventory.selection: All supplied maps/*.bsp excluding hm_* and ctf_*; each has info_player_start; case-insensitive sorted pak precedence.

manualStage.saveIntegrityUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after checked SP save writes/close, preserved saves on failure, honest save messages and hub failure handling. Full Windows suite, Linux builds/sanitizers and real file obstruction/recovery/save round trips verified.

saveIntegrityReadmeUpdate.scope: Current engine provenance paragraph only; user settings, saves and launchers unchanged

safety.homes: Independent copies and writable homes; real installation unchanged
safety.input: Mouse/joystick and feedback disabled; no input control/capture/injection
safety.fileFaults: Owned empty directory blocks current.sav creation; owned destination handles deny delete sharing to block replacement. Each obstruction removed before recovery. No volume exhaustion or installation changes.
safety.retention: Useful logs/captures/scripts in worktree .tmp/stvef-gaps and authorized E:/Games/fnTech3-tests homes

limits: Controlled write and close faults, not power-loss durability or fsync guarantees.
